behavior: The map inspector's Evidence tab lists the building's links to register rows and document pages, read only. It reads the building's intake target by feature (the same query and key as the property card), then GET /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/intake/evidence with featureId = the selected building's feature id through @ulpin/api-client, and the batch manifest for file names. Each link shows the file name, the row or page in the native reader's words (CSV logical row N, Sheet S, row N, Page N), the key as written (the column header and cell literal, or the officer's key name and the quoted literal for a document), the outcome in words (Matched, Several buildings, Conflicting, Unmatched; with the batch's outcome words beside a non-match and the other buildings a conflicting or several key also names), and the review: cited on the record revision the target's evidence artefact names, confirmed by the officer, confirmed before its file was read again, or a candidate not confirmed. No targets, no candidates: 'No register row or page names this building.' A failed target or evidence read says so with the server's words inside the section only; the rest of the panel stays. Case-wide counts are not shown. No raw codes or UUIDs, no hard-coded sample values; a first page with a next cursor says more links are listed in the batch and links to it.

files.reused: buildingWords and outcomeWords from apps/studio/src/features/intake/evidence/model.ts (import only, unchanged); buildingTargetKey and readTargetByFeature (the property card's read); useIntakeManifest; evidenceKey (the links sit under the batch's evidence key, so a batch refresh reads them again).
files.notReused: evidenceWords words a row as 'row N' with its column; the task and the native reader word it 'CSV logical row N', so evidence.ts adds linkPlaceWords, matching packages/server/src/modules/registry/registry-table-evidence.ts tableRowLocatorWords (read only).
